c74object.name: evi_buchla
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_buchla.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_buchla.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_buchla.genexpr file also requires:
evi_interp.genexpr
evi_smooth.genexpr
About this File:
Buchla Lowpass Gate emulation. A filter modified from 'A Digital Model of the Buchla Lowpass-Gate' by Julian Parker and Stefano D’Angelo, 2013. This file renders multiple versions of the filter for 1x..8x oversampling (with multiple passes of the processing loop in each one) and their subsequent oversampled functions. These can be used entirely inside gen~ code without resorting to using an external [poly~] for the resampling. Note, this file contains only the filter without the feeding circuit control. For an MSP/[poly~] version with circuit control see the [evi.lpg~] abstraction instead.

entry.name: buchlaLpg1 ( )
entry.description:
1x version of the filter. This version is unique in this file in that it offers 3 simultaneous outlets for mixing (LP, BP, HP) but not being oversampled it is not very useful.
In 1: type=input: x, Audio Input
In 2: type=input: rf, Voltage (not Hz) controls cutoff
In 3: type=input: res, Resonance 0..2..
In 4: type=input: resist, Additional resistors 0..1, also known as 'Boom'
In 5: type=input: vcamode, Vca mode 0..1, also known as 'Damp'
In 6: type=input: lpgmode, Filter/LPG mode flag 0/1
In 7: type=input: nl, Nonlin flag 0/1, switch linear/nonliner, typically on
Return 1: LPG, Lowpass Gate output
Return 2: BP, Bandpass filter output
Return 3: HP, Highpass filter output
